supporting_observations.claim: Ana Ruiz ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-PIN-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\ana.ruiz\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; Sysmon recorded creation of that archive.
Ana Ruiz then launched Chrome with https://dropzone-transfer.net/ as its argument.

The proxy recorded Ana Ruiz connecting to dropzone-transfer.net over a tunnel and sending 51,000,000 client-to-server bytes, with only 8,800 server-to-client bytes; Zeek records a matching large connection to the explicit proxy.
The sequence of archiving the Clients share, opening an unapproved transfer site, and sending tens of megabytes supports a malicious exfiltration finding for the alerted activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records a CONNECT tunnel and byte counts, not the encrypted tunnel's contents, so the transferred payload cannot be identified from these records. (T069-00194, T069-00196)
claims_not_established: The records do not establish that c.zip was the specific file uploaded, or that the 51,000,000 bytes contained the Clients archive. (T069-00142, T069-00144, T069-00194, T069-00196)
The records do not establish the archive's contents, the recipient's identity, or Ana Ruiz's intent. (T069-00142, T069-00144, T069-00194)
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve WS-ARUIZ-01 and collect c.zip metadata, hash, and contents, plus file-share access records for the Clients directory.
Obtain browser history and relevant browser/cache artifacts to determine what was selected or uploaded to dropzone-transfer.net.
Review proxy, DNS, and available TLS inspection or destination intelligence for the transfer and domain.
Interview Ana Ruiz and verify whether the transfer had an authorized business purpose.
unrelated_findings: Dropbox updater execution was observed on WS-ARUIZ-01 despite the inventory listing no other approved file-sharing or cloud-storage services. The records show updater execution, not a Dropbox transfer; investigate separately. (T069-00006, T069-00008, T069-00112, T069-00133)

Palo Alto GlobalProtect PanGPS.exe started on WS-ARUIZ-01, while the inventory says there is no VPN; these records do not show it participating in the alerted transfer. Investigate separately. (T069-00028, T069-00029)
